intent: K7, Phase 1: the recon the plan waits on. The 2026-09-11 codebase review was read-only by rule, and it says so eleven times: its evidence file carries eleven separate 'Not examined' lists. Some of what it could not do is measurement that needs a command run (npm audit and outdated, licences against NOTICE, a gitleaks history scan, bundle size per route, whether a script-src CSP can work with Next's inline scripts, playwright --list, fresh coverage, knip widened, the Docker image's contents, whether next build needs a database, the repository's own branch-protection settings). The rest is reading it did not reach: SQLite dead data at column rather than table level, the eleven large pages, the 93 unclassified source-text suites, rec-room's client reads, the LOCKBOOK rulings against the code, a cycle check by a real tool rather than a regex. Phase 2's plan sets its targets from these numbers, and the operator approves that plan, so a number that is a guess here becomes a target nobody can hit or a target already met.

side_effects: next build and the jest/playwright runs write their usual gitignored output (.next, coverage, test-results); nothing else is written outside org/reviews/

reasons.evidence: the batch produces one document under org/reviews/ and changes no product code, no gate and no configuration. Its risk is not to the tree but to the plan that reads it: a wrong number here is a target the operator approves.

programme: K7 of the refactor and clean-up programme, and the whole of Phase 1. Phase 0 closed at T-0154 with every job green on a0983620. Phase 2 (the plan) reads this document and the committed census baselines; the operator approves that plan before any Phase 3 batch starts.
invariants: I1 EVERY CLAIM CARRIES A COMMAND OR A file:line. A recon whose numbers cannot be re-derived is a recon that has to be redone. Where a number is an estimate, it says so and says what it rests on.

I2 A SCEPTIC DEFAULTS TO REFUTED. Each dimension is checked by a session that did not gather it and that is told to refute; a finding that cannot be independently reproduced does not enter the document as a fact.

I3 THE GATES ARE THE ONES K6 FIXED. Every measurement is taken with the gates as they now stand, and the document says so: the old review's numbers for routesWithTryCatch, raw controls, the link gate's scope and scripts/ were taken through instruments that could not see, and this recon supersedes them wherever a number moved.

I4 NOTHING IS INSTALLED OR CHANGED TO GET A NUMBER. gitleaks is not installed without the operator's say-so, no config is widened to make knip report more, and no gate is loosened to let a measurement through. Where a measurement needs something the batch may not do, the document records what is needed and why it was not taken.
I5 THE DOCUMENT SUPERSEDES, IT DOES NOT REPLACE. It says which of the review's numbers moved and by how much, so the register's rulings can be re-read against the truth rather than quietly re-based.
rollback: The batch adds one document under org/reviews/ and touches nothing else, so a revert is deleting a file. The measurements write only the gitignored build, coverage and test-results output the gate already writes.
